title: Koijen, Moskowitz, Pedersen, Vrugt 2018 JFE Carry: equity index futures carry (dividend yield minus rate)
note: Different mechanism from FX carry: carry of US500/US100/GER40 futures = expected dividend yield minus financing; long high-carry indices. Read NBER pdf; check post-2013 table. Data: index CFD swap/dividend adjustments, FRED rates. Scout 2026-11-03.

title: Gorton, Hayashi, Rouwenhorst 2013 Fundamentals of commodity futures returns (basis signal)
note: Commodity carry from futures basis: apply to XAUUSD/XAGUSD via GC futures term structure vs T-bill (lease-rate carry). Free data: CME settlement or FRED. Check whether the gold basis timing has any post-2018 value.

title: van Binsbergen, Brandt, Koijen 2012 On the timing and pricing of dividends
note: Short-dated dividend claims vs index; ex-dividend-date seasonality of US500/GER40 CFDs (dividend adjustment credit). Index CFD carry via dividend adjustment: test long index across ex-div weeks.

title: Daniel, Hodrick, Lu 2017 The carry trade: risks and drawdowns (JFQA)
note: Carry with a drawdown-avoiding rule (skip carry when the currency-vol or funding-risk indicator is high); check whether the 2018+ result is positive on AUDJPY/NZDJPY/USDJPY yen crosses only. FX carry failed halves before: only queue if filter is a different mechanism.

title: Brunnermeier, Nagel, Pedersen 2008 Carry trades and currency crashes
note: Use risk-reversal/skew as carry timing on yen crosses; the free proxy is realised skew of daily returns. Check if previously rejected (Brunnermeier appears in backlog_done line 251).

title: Lustig, Roussanov, Verdelhan 2014 Countercyclical currency risk premia (dollar carry)
note: Dollar carry: go long all USD pairs when average forward discount is positive (US rate above world average). Long/short basket of USD majors on one signal, timed monthly; weeks+ horizon.

title: Own: yen-cross carry only when VIX below its 1y median
note: Pre-registered variant of FX carry near-misses: carry on AUDJPY, NZDJPY, GBPJPY, CADJPY same parameters, on only when VIX below rolling 250d median; counts toward DSR N.

title: Own: FTMO swap-table carry (long highest swap pairs, hold weeks)
note: FTMO publishes swap points per symbol; test whether a long-the-positive-swap basket (earning swap) survives with the actual swap in tester data from export_mt5_data. Check docs/ftmo_specs.json.

title: Moreira & Muir 2017 JF Volatility-managed portfolios applied to the book's legs
note: Sizing existing legs inversely to trailing realised variance (monthly). Check rejected sizing versions via memory.py search vol managed first (Moreira appears in sources several times).

title: Lopez de Prado 2018 Advances in Financial ML ch. 3: meta-labeling the breakout leg
note: Gradient-boosted classifier takes the breakout leg's (weight 0.25) trades and predicts win/loss from past-only features (ATR rank, hour, prior-day range, spread); size by probability. Closest rejected: daily ML; differs by meta-label on an existing leg.

title: Boyarchenko, Larsen, Whelan 2023 RFS The overnight drift
note: Overnight drift in US indices tied to dealer inventory around 8am; check memory (overnight drift appears in sources many times) and only queue if new variant.

title: Baltussen, Da, Lammers, Martens 2021 JFE Hedging demand and market intraday momentum
note: Last half hour return predicted by gamma exposure; family intraday momentum rejected, so only if the gamma-conditioned variant is new.

title: Krohn, Mueller, Whelan 2024 JF FX fixing returns around the clock
note: EURUSD fixing-time returns (4pm London, WMR); fix leg exists, so check if the EURUSD pair is covered and what hours.

title: Ranaldo & Rossi 2010 The reaction of asset markets to Swiss National Bank communication / ECB pre-announcement drift in EURUSD
note: Pick ECB WP on EURUSD around ECB press conferences (14:15 CET): fade/follow first 15 min. Event rule on EURUSD, the no-leg market.

title: Breedon & Ranaldo 2013 Intraday patterns in FX returns and order flow (EURUSD buys at London hours)
note: Home-currency selling during local hours: EURUSD falls in European hours, rises in US hours. Rule: short EURUSD 07-12 GMT, long 13-17 GMT. Test on EURUSD 2018+ with costs.

title: Cieslak, Morse, Vissing-Jorgensen 2019 FOMC cycle applied to EURUSD
note: Even-week FOMC cycle: dollar moves in even weeks. Check Cieslak already in sources (line 1180); only queue if a EURUSD variant is new.

title: Londono & Zhou 2017 JFE Variance risk premiums and the forward premium puzzle
note: Check sources line 759 (Londono) first; skip if read.

title: Bollerslev, Tauchen, Zhou 2009 Expected stock returns and variance risk premia
note: Monthly US500 return predicted by VIX^2 minus realised variance; quarterly horizon. Weeks+ horizon, VIX from FRED. VRP alone failed before; use as a long-only timing filter of US500, the style differs.

title: Gold implied vol (GVZ) minus realised vol as XAUUSD timing
note: Short-term: GVZ/realised ratio high predicts gold mean-reversion next days. GVZ variants in VRP gap tried; check memory first.

title: Tail-risk: Kelly & Jiang 2014 tail risk and asset prices
note: Monthly tail-risk measure predicts US500 return; needs stock panel, so use proxy of industry portfolio returns. Gap weeks+.

title: Quantpedia: Turn-of-the-quarter / FX month-end rebalancing flows
note: Browse Quantpedia forex category page, pick a non-carry rule with a specific signal. Month-end fix leg exists; look at quarter-end differences.

title: Quantpedia commodities category (gold, silver rules)
note: Crawl page 1; pick gold or silver rule that is not trend or carry (e.g. gold-silver ratio mean reversion, gold seasonality).

title: Gold-silver ratio mean reversion: XAUUSD vs XAGUSD pair
note: Pairs spread z-score of log(XAU/XAG), entry |z|>2 over 60d, exit 0. Check XAGUSD data presence and prior pairs rejection via memory search.

title: MQL5 CodeBase experts list page 1 (EURUSD, readable source)
note: Pick one expert with source file and non-trend EURUSD rule; read in full.

title: AQR library: Hurst, Ooi, Pedersen A century of evidence on trend-following / Asness 'Value and momentum everywhere'
note: Only non-trend items: AQR 'Betting against beta' applied to index futures (low-beta indices vs high-beta). Pick one and read in full.

title: Frazzini & Pedersen 2014 Betting against beta: country index version
note: Long low-beta / short high-beta index (US500 vs US100, GER40, JPN225) beta-neutral monthly. Different from the book's styles; data on FTMO indices.

title: BIS WP: cross-currency basis and FX swap carry (Du, Tepper, Verdelhan 2018 JF)
note: Basis-based EURUSD/USDJPY timing: widening basis predicts dollar strength. Free data: FRED/ECB rates; basis itself needs Bloomberg, so check proxy (3m OIS spread). Drop if no free proxy.
